end.summary:
Manav named plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and an animal that eats both.
They built and read food chains using arrows.
They predicted effects of removing grass, owls, and bees from food chains.
They described differences between cow and lion teeth.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, food-chain arrows, and what can happen when one part of a chain is removed. Manav correctly followed several chains and explained linked effects, including fewer fruits when bees are absent. At home, ask them to draw one food chain and explain what may happen if one part disappears.
